scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?
scores.answer:
These agreements give a party audit, inspection, or records-review rights:

- CCA Industries Outsourcing Agreement: Company and its representatives may inspect and access Contractor’s properties, records, and personnel [CCAINDUSTRIESINC_04_14_2014-EX-10.1-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3].
- Bizzingo Endorsement Agreement: Theismann may inspect Bizzingo’s books, records, and related materials [BizzingoInc_20120322_8-K_EX-10.17_7504499_EX-10.17_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 4].
- Performance Sports Brands Endorsement Agreement: North may inspect Company’s books and records [PerformanceSportsBrandsInc_20110909_S-1_EX-10.10_7220214_EX-10.10_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 6].
- 2Themart Co-Branding Agreement: 2TheMart may inspect and audit i-Escrow’s records through a CPA [2ThemartComInc_19990826_10-12G_EX-10.10_6700288_EX-10.10_Co-Branding Agreement_ Agency Agreement.pdf p. 3].
- Ambassador Eyewear Endorsement Agreement: KI, Inc. may examine Diplomat’s books and records [AMBASSADOREYEWEARGROUPINC_11_17_1997-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 10].
- N2K Sponsorship Agreement: Excite may inspect Sponsor’s records [N2KINC_10_16_1997-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 10].
- Anixa Collaboration Agreement: each party may inspect specified records, and Anixa may inspect expense records [ANIXABIOSCIENCESINC_06_09_2020-EX-10.1-COLLABORATION AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 3, 5].
- CNS Development Agreement: CNS may review WPD’s and its affiliates’ books and records for compliance [CnsPharmaceuticalsInc_20200326_8-K_EX-10.1_12079626_EX-10.1_Development Agreement.pdf p. 7].
- Legacy Education Alliance Development Agreement: a party may verify records, reports, and payments [LegacyEducationAllianceInc_20200330_10-K_EX-10.18_12090678_EX-10.18_Development Agreement.pdf p. 7].
